$description: Closed assetRole enum wired through schema/pagespec.schema.json (definitions.assetRole) and every section contract's media fields. This project's source is a real company's site (Mirai Labs' live marketing site) reference-cloned into this repo — see the source project's own README.md, 'Where this differs from the original' — so every role below carries explicit AI-generation guidance AND explicit licensing guidance. This is treated as a compliance requirement, not a style note.
measuredFrom: public/ asset inventory (~40 files) cross-referenced against every /background usage in src/**/*.jsx

brand-mark-placeholder.description: The Mirai Labs wordmark (an inline SVG <text> placeholder, src/components/Navbar.jsx Wordmark) and the canvas-drawn orbital marks (Closing.jsx, Careers.jsx). Both are explicitly documented as neutral placeholders reconstructed from measured geometry, not Mirai Labs' real brand artwork.
brand-mark-placeholder.generationNote: A generator MAY produce a new abstract/geometric mark or a new text-set wordmark in this style.
brand-mark-placeholder.licensingGuidance: MUST NOT attempt to reproduce, approximate, or reverse-engineer Mirai Labs' real logo/wordmark/brand identity. Any generated mark must remain visibly generic/abstract, never a plausible stand-in for the real company's actual brand art.
brand-mark-placeholder.citation: README.md 'Where this differs from the original' (source project's own README.md)

real-investor-logo.description: The 8 investor/team backer logos on /about-us: Y Combinator, Stripe, Uncork Capital, MLX, and four named individuals (Ben, Gokul, Marcin, Mati).
real-investor-logo.generationNote: A generator MUST reference one of the real files above by exact path, never synthesize a new mark for a named real investor or person.
real-investor-logo.licensingGuidance: MUST NOT fabricate a logo for a real company or a real named individual not already in this list. These are real third-party/personal marks reproduced under the original site's own display; a generator adding a NEW backer must be given a real, licensed asset file — it must never invent one.

third-party-company-logo.description: Real AI model/company marks used as provenance icons: LiquidAI, Llama (Meta), Qwen (Alibaba).
third-party-company-logo.generationNote: A generator MUST reference one of the real files above; never redraw or approximate a real company's mark.
third-party-company-logo.licensingGuidance: MUST NOT fabricate a new third-party company logo. If a new model family needs a provenance mark, that requires a real licensed asset supplied by a human, not a generated approximation of a real company's trademark.

language-icon.description: Generic programming-language marks (Kotlin, Python, Rust, Swift, TypeScript) used in the SDK install matrix.
language-icon.generationNote: A generator MUST reference one of the real files above for an existing supported language.
language-icon.licensingGuidance: Lower compliance risk than a company's own brand (these are widely-used public language marks), but still real trademarked identities — MUST NOT fabricate a mark for a language not in this list; flag it for a human to supply the real asset instead.

photographic-backdrop.description: Full-bleed sunset-themed cover photography used as a backdrop behind framed terminal/browser compositions and the chat-for-mac hero.
photographic-backdrop.generationNote: A generator MAY produce new generic atmospheric/landscape backdrop photography in a similar tone, or reuse one of the real files above.
photographic-backdrop.licensingGuidance: No real-brand risk (generic landscape photography), but MUST NOT depict a real identifiable person, real Mirai Labs office/product photography, or any real trademarked scene.

product-screenshot.description: The macOS app screenshot used on /chat-for-mac (a single real file reused for both the desktop and mobile framed views — the two upstream names resolve to the same bytes, per the code comment).
product-screenshot.generationNote: A generator MUST reference the real file; a product screenshot is not something to hallucinate.
product-screenshot.licensingGuidance: MUST NOT fabricate a new screenshot implying real, unreleased product UI. If the real app's UI changes, a human must supply a new real screenshot.
product-screenshot.citation: src/pages/ChatForMac.jsx AppView + code comment on mockup-window/mockup-mobile dedup

decorative-icon.description: Generic decorative pictograms with no real-brand meaning: conversion/optimization pipeline icons, model-family engine icons, persona icons ('model companies', 'researchers', 'makers'), the app-icon glyph.
decorative-icon.generationNote: A generator MAY create new pictograms matching the existing line-icon style for a new concept.
decorative-icon.licensingGuidance: Low risk (generic pictograms), but MUST NOT reproduce Apple's own trademarked icon marks beyond the existing generic Apple-Silicon reference already in use, and must stay in the established minimal-line style.

blog-cover-image.generationNote: A generator MAY produce new generic abstract cover art for a new post.
blog-cover-image.licensingGuidance: MUST NOT fabricate imagery implying a real, specific Mirai Labs research result or real screenshot of proprietary internal tooling not actually published.

generic-avatar-placeholder.description: The generic person-silhouette avatar used on the about-us team cards, explicitly standing in for withheld real photographs.
generic-avatar-placeholder.generationNote: A generator MAY vary the silhouette style, as long as it remains obviously generic/anonymous.
generic-avatar-placeholder.licensingGuidance: MUST NOT generate or imply a photorealistic portrait of any real Mirai Labs founder or employee. This role exists specifically because real team photography is intentionally withheld in this clone (src/pages/AboutUs.jsx comment: 'This clone keeps the card layout and leaves the people anonymous').

favicon-app-icon.description: Favicon and app-icon assets tightly coupled to brand identity.
favicon-app-icon.generationNote: A generator MUST reference the real files; these are not appropriate targets for on-the-fly generation.
favicon-app-icon.licensingGuidance: hf-logo.svg is Hugging Face's real mark, reused as a footer link icon (must-reuse-exact, must-not-fabricate a substitute). The icon-dark/icon-light/favicon/apple-touch-icon set follows the same neutral-placeholder rule as brand-mark-placeholder — they are not Mirai Labs' real icon artwork.
favicon-app-icon.reservedNote: Real files exist and are cited (public/favicon.ico, apple-touch-icon.png, hf-logo.svg via Footer.jsx), but this role is never selected as a section media assetRole in practice -- favicons/app-icons are static site metadata, not composable page content. Intentionally reserved, not an accidental unused role.
